info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Streaming Subscriptions Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Status API provides real-time insights into the status of various streaming subscriptions. It allows users to retrieve the current state of their subscriptions, enabling them to monitor performance and troubleshoot issues effectively. This endpoint is typically utilized by developers and system administrators seeking to maintain optimal service delivery for clients reliant on streaming services. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure timely access to subscription data and enhance user experiences.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of subscriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of all active subscriptions. It provides insights into the subscription state, helping you manage and track subscription activities effectively.
